name: Irohanihoheto
source:
During the Taishou era, Izumi Ichika is working as a waitress at a cafe in Ginza.

One day, when she went to work as usual, the store manager asked her an outrageous request... 

"Please introduce me to a handsome man!"

But she doesn't know anyone who she can think of. That's when six regular customers came to mind...

Is it possible to ask one of them?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5205]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
大正时代，泉一花在银座的一家咖啡馆担任女招待。

某天，她像往常一样去上班，店长却提出了一个离谱的请求……

“请给我介绍一位美男子！”

可她认识的人里，实在想不到合适的人选。这时，六位常客浮现在她脑海中……

能否请他们之中的某一位帮这个忙呢？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5205]NovelGame[/url]]
